title: b7z9.35(b): C gateway — register tunnel_auth CoAP resource + app wiring
description: Child of b7z9.35. lichen/subsys/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.c (receive 327-367, decapsulate 416-457) compiles into the gateway subsys but has no coap_server resource registration and no app reference (grep lichen/apps/ = 0 hits). Wire: register the /.well-known/tunnel-auth resource in the C coap_server, reference the auth check from the gateway app egress path, and confirm the permit()/deny() literal 204/403 ints (tunnel_auth.c:24-33) map to CoAP 2.04 (0x44)/4.03 (0x83) at the wiring boundary. Host tests under lichen/tests/tunnel_auth.
